# Schedule

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

When a scope is active (#38).

Times are wall-clock times in the schedule's time zone. A window starts
on one of its days at `start` and lasts until `end` (which may be on
the next day: `22:00` to `06:00` wraps midnight) or for `duration_mins`.
With no windows, every time of day is in. `dates` and `except_dates`
test the local date of the moment being decided.

Appears at: `/policy/rule_set_scopes/scopes/schedule`, `/policy/scope/schedule`, `/policy/unknown/scope_limits/all_of/schedule`, `/policy/unknown/scope_limits/any_of/schedule`, `/policy/unknown/scopes/schedule`, `/rule_sets/rules/scope/schedule`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dates` | array of [`DateRange`](date-range.md) | no |  | at most 1000 items | 1.0.0 | Absolute date ranges. Empty means every date. |
| `except_dates` | array of [`DateRange`](date-range.md) | no |  | at most 1000 items | 1.0.0 | Dates on which the schedule is never active, such as holidays. |
| `grace_secs` | integer | no |  | 0 to 86400; format `uint32` | 1.0.0 | Seconds between the warning and termination, for `warn_then_terminate`. Default 300. |
| `on_window_close` | [`OnWindowClose`](types.md#onwindowclose) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | Only for rules that let an object run: what happens to running processes when the schedule closes. |
| `timezone_basis` | [`TimeZoneBasis`](types.md#timezonebasis) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | The clock the times are read on. Unset means the policy's `settings.time_zone_basis`. |
| `windows` | array of [`Window`](window.md) | no |  | at most 64 items | 1.0.0 | The weekly windows. Empty means all day, every day. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
